definitions.explanation: Corn kernels that have been heated until they burst open into light, fluffy pieces. A popular snack at movie theaters, theme parks, and festivals in Japan.

examples.japanese: ポップコーン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}おう→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ポップコーン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。

notes:
A loanword from English "popcorn." In Japan, popcorn is strongly associated with movie theaters and theme parks, particularly Tokyo Disney Resort, where limited-edition popcorn buckets (ポップコーンバケット) are popular collectibles.

Japanese popcorn comes in a wider variety of flavors than in many Western countries. In addition to standard ⟦{塩味|しおあじ}→塩味：12106_shioaji⟧ (salted) and ⟦キャラメル→キャラメル：10837_kyarameru⟧ (caramel), Japanese movie theaters and vendors often offer flavors like ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧ (soy sauce butter), ⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧ (curry), and ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ (matcha).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ポップコーン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make popcorn
- ⟦キャラメル→キャラメル：10837_kyarameru⟧ポップコーン: caramel popcorn
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ポップコーン: salted popcorn
- ポップコーンバケット: popcorn bucket (collectible container)
- ポップコーン⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: popcorn stand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とうもろこし→とうもろこし：10394_toumorokoshi⟧: corn — the base grain, not the snack
- ⟦スナック→スナック：27527_sunakku⟧: snack — a broader category that includes popcorn
- {綿菓子|わたがし}: cotton candy — another festival/amusement park snack
